title: Ivori
subtitle: 8 Multi-Level Boutique Townhouses
description: Ivori is a prestigious boutique development of 8 luxury townhouses nestled on a generous lot in Glen Iris. Situated within a historic neighbourhood, the minimalist material palette of its external façade brings contemporary sophistication whilst sitting in serene harmony with surrounding heritage homes. The residences feature expansive open-plan layouts flooded with natural light, bespoke light oak timber finishes, and signature brass fixtures.
features: Open-plan living spaces bathed in natural daylight
Subtle textural finishes with warm light oak accents
Custom brass kitchen and bathroom fixtures
Heritage-harmonious contemporary exterior form

title: Tennyson
subtitle: Contemporary Architectural Residence
description: A bespoke double-storey luxury home designed to harness natural east-west sunlight. The upper floor gently overhangs to provide passive solar shading over expansive floor-to-ceiling glazing. Dark timber cladding functions as thermal screening, while inside, a sculpted continuous curved staircase anchors the residence as an architectural masterpiece.
features: Signature curved sculptural staircase connecting levels
Generous double-height windows and ambient skylights
Architectural overhangs and dark timber sun screens
Curated transition between open entertainment and private zones

title: Coppin
subtitle: Heritage Restoration & Contemporary Extension
description: Located in the prestigious Gascoigne Estate near Central Park, this project was an intricate transformation of a solid brick Edwardian residence. The design meticulously preserved period details—ornate ceiling roses, colonial cornices, and timber craftsmanship—while seamlessly integrating a striking rear extension featuring Verde marble, custom fireplaces, and full-height garden glass.
features: Heritage façade preservation with ornate colonial mouldings
Ultra-luxe Verde marble benchtops and forest green feature tiles
Seamless indoor-outdoor garden connectivity
Custom architectural wall panelling throughout

title: TAO Dumplings
subtitle: Contemporary Asian Dining & Bar
description: Designed for the renowned culinary brand's flagship Mentone venue. The interior marries traditional oriental accents with sleek modern bistro architecture. Meticulously selected red pendant lights, vertical hanging botanical planters, and a soft tea-green feature wine bar create an energetic yet intimate dining atmosphere.
features: Custom tea-green feature bar with integrated wine display niches
Bespoke red architectural pendant lighting scheme
Lush vertical hanging greenery and warm wood elements
High-traffic acoustic and spatial flow design

title: Ma Ma Mee
subtitle: Modern Asian Fusion Restaurant & Bar
description: A comprehensive transformation creating a warm, industrial-luxe dining destination. The space features grey micro-cement textured walls, sweeping curved ceiling profiles, custom arched bottle display joinery, vibrant neon cultural art, and rich terracotta and timber finishes.
features: Signature curved ceiling and rhythmic wall arches
Micro-cement texture finishes and bespoke warm joinery
Central cocktail bar with custom illumination
Vibrant neon signage celebrating Asian culinary culture

title: Thompsons
subtitle: Mixed-Use Apartments & Early Learning Facility
description: A landmark multi-storey mixed-use development combining premium modern apartments with an integrated state-of-the-art childcare learning centre. Designed with distinct pedestrian activations, secure multi-tier parking, and sound-insulated community living.
features: Integrated childcare facility and residential lobby zoning
Expansive balconies with panoramic suburban vistas
Acoustic engineering and energy-efficient building envelope
Modern minimalist exterior with stone and composite cladding

title: Eunoia Education Childcare
subtitle: Purpose-Built Early Learning & Play Centre
description: An architectural early learning facility designed around principles of organic exploration, abundant natural daylight, and secure indoor-outdoor play zones. Features ergonomic learning spaces, biophilic materials, and expansive landscaped adventure yards.
features: Biophilic architectural layout emphasizing natural light and timber
Secure zoning with shaded outdoor exploration pavilions
Child-centric ergonomics and non-toxic sustainable finishes
Dedicated creative arts, stem, and culinary learning studios
